messages:
charlie: starting canary for quant-kernel v2.3 -> NA-west 5% to GPUA / 5% to GPUB. watching perf + errors, window 30m.

deploybot: :rocket: rollout started (id=rb-1758873000). canary slices: na-west:5%/5% (GPUTypes=A100/GPUB=RTX6000), na-east:5%, eu-west:5%. window=30m.

kevin: quick heads up — in staging GPUB (RTX6000) showed kernel launch failures on a subset of drivers. small sample log attached.

maya: paste logs:
```
[2025-06-12T18:02:13Z] quant_kernel.cu:launch() error: kernel_launch failed: CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_PTX
stack: /opt/runtime/quant/launcher.cpp:144
config: batch=8, seq=2048, qtype=4
```

kevin: same repro with quant build x86_2025_06_11, not with x86_2025_06_09. suspect compiler flags changed.

charlie: thanks. proposal: pin NA-west back to kernel 2.2 for now to avoid user impact, let canary continue in other regions while kevin runs diag builds. decision call?

sre-oncall: define rollback criteria before we pin:
- error rate >= 1.5% sustained over 10m OR
- p95 latency +50ms vs baseline for 10m
If either hit, auto-rollback entire canary.

maya: +1 to criteria. also suggest TTL on the pin so it doesn't become permanent.

deploybot: executing pin: `/deploybot pin region=na-west kernel=2.2 ttl=6h reason="quant-kernel GPUB instability"`

deploybot: :white_check_mark: pin applied. na-west traffic will remain on kernel 2.2 until TTL expires or manual unpin.

product-docs: noted — I'll add a short line to the release notes and internal changelog: "NA-west temporarily pinned to kernel 2.2 due to GPUB/driver regression; full rollout delayed." linking to PR once live.

kevin: spinning a debug/diag quant build (x86_diag_2025_06_12) that enables extra kernel assertions and dumps kernel params on failure. will run canary in a small staging fleet first.

charlie: plan for next steps:
1) monitor canary metrics in other regions for 1h. if stable, proceed to staged ramp to 25% (excluding na-west).
2) kevin to deliver diag build and root cause ETA.
3) product-docs to ship release note bullet + customer-facing blurb if we extend pin.
4) set on-call alarm if rollback criteria trigger.

deploybot: canary progress update (10m): na-east 10% -> OK, eu-west 5% -> OK, na-west pinned -> no change. :eyes:

maya: scheduling note — this started at 18:00 PT; avoid touching kernel pins during our 22:00-06:00 night window unless emergency.

sre-oncall: creating alert channel and dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/r/quant-canary/1758873000. will add a 5m aggregation panel for errors and p95.

kevin: diag run in staging now. initial logs show the kernel receives an unexpected constant buffer layout when compiled with nvcc 12.2. trying a compile flag rollback.

charlie: if diag confirms compiler flag regression, we can either: A) rebuild with older flags and resume rollout, or B) backport a narrowly scoped kernel fix. prefer A for speed.

maya: agree. also document the regional fallback in the incident notes so customer success has context.

product-docs: drafted note and uploaded to internal docs: https://docs.internal/release/quant-v2.3-notes (will add final wording after we decide).

kevin: ETA for a candidate rebuild: ~2h. if rebuild passes staging, we'll request a controlled unpin and restart ramp excluding night window.

charlie: decision summary (for changelog):
- action: applied regional pin for NA-west to kernel 2.2 (ttl=6h)
- reason: GPUB/driver + compiler flag regression causing CUDA kernel failures in quant build v2.3
- rollback criteria: error rate >=1.5% (10m) or p95 +50ms (10m)
- next steps: diag rebuild (kevin) -> staging -> resume ramp excluding NA-west -> review in morning for global rollout

maya: tagging @customer-success to prep messages if we need to extend pin beyond ttl. :thumbsup:

kevin: will post logs and final verdict in this thread when done.

charlie: thanks everyone. keep updates short here. ping me for manual unpin when safe. :white_check_mark:
